method: All 32 contact sheets covering 504 pages were viewed with view_image; automated PDF text, links and page geometry checks are recorded separately.
observations: No clipping, overlapping text or missing Korean glyphs observed at contact-sheet scale.
Condition histories and some headings split across pages; Tesla/AMD eyebrow headings and Microsoft history heading need improved pagination.
Some continuation pages contain substantial white space; this is a layout follow-up, not approval of publication typography.
scope: Visual page coverage only; not financial interpretation approval or a claim that every small text was proofread at native resolution.
